license.name: Non-commercial / no SLA
license.attribution: Airplanes.live ADS-B + MLAT data. Attribution appreciated; not formally required for non-commercial use.

attribution_required: Appreciated; no formal requirement. UI must display the non-commercial / no-SLA caveat (see ADR-002).
what_it_provides: Live global ADS-B + MLAT aircraft positions. Military, LADD, and PIA aircraft globally via dedicated endpoints. Civil aircraft only within a camera-region /point call (max 250 nm radius). No global civil endpoint exists. No SLA; no uptime guarantee. Non-commercial use only.

refresh_policy.schedule_note: 5-second cycle: /mil, /ladd, /pia, and one /point (camera region) per cycle. Hard rate limit 1 request/second (RATE_LIMIT_SECONDS = 1.0). Do not tile the globe with /point calls.

freshness_policy.notes: STALE_ACTIVE_THRESHOLD=30s, STALE_FADE_THRESHOLD=90s, STALE_PURGE_THRESHOLD=300s. Frontend fades then drops aircraft past these thresholds.

raw_storage.bucket: n/a (no raw blob persisted; per-record JSONB in aviation_aircraft_raw_batches.raw_sample)
raw_storage.path_pattern: not applicable — see aviation_aircraft_raw_batches table instead
raw_storage.notes: Live aircraft raw evidence is stored in the aviation_aircraft_raw_batches table (with http_status, source_now_ts, source_ctime_ts, source_ptime_ms, and a small raw_sample). The canonical raw path pattern from PROJECT_CONTROL.md §13 is not used for this live stream; raw-sample payloads are capped to the first 5 records per batch.

normalizer.name: normalize_aircraft (inline in worker)
normalizer.notes: Live aircraft normalization is performed inline in the worker. There is no separate normalizer module under services/normalizer/ for this source.

target_tables: aviation_aircraft_live_snapshots (per migration 013 — used by the broadcaster for the WebSocket payload)

frontend_usage.transport: WebSocket (snapshot + delta) for live, REST for latest-list / detail

known_limitations: No global civil aircraft endpoint — civil coverage is limited to a single /point call per 5s cycle (max 250 nm radius).
No SLA; non-commercial only; documented in ADR-002.
The 'ground' string sentinel in alt_baro is normalised to on_ground=true and altitude_baro_ft=null.

Airplanes.live returns the most recent batch; the WebSocket broadcaster currently exposes a single-source stream keyed on source_id='airplanes_live_v2' (see global-web-json mode for a separate dev source id).
No 30-day retention on observations; this is a live snapshot stream.
ui_caveat: Live aircraft data: Airplanes.live (non-commercial / no SLA). Civil aircraft shown within camera region only. Military / LADD / PIA shown globally. Not authoritative aviation data. Coverage may be incomplete.
notes: Source decision and selection rationale: docs/decisions/ADR-002-aviation-live-source.md (status: DECIDED).
The source row in aviation_aircraft_sources uses license_type='non_commercial', is_live=TRUE, is_historical=FALSE, is_active=TRUE, refresh_interval_s=5, rate_limit_per_sec=1.
DB source_id is the primary key and matches this catalog source_id: 'airplanes_live_v2'.
If a future build ever becomes commercial, a new agreement with Airplanes.live is required before continuing to use this API.
